title: When analysis is not enough
summary: Ambiguity, partial results, and warnings. Parts of the analysis are heuristic; recognizing those limits is part of using AALIE wisely.

learningObjectives.text: Identify typical situations (complex WHILE, multiple variables, off-pattern recursion) where output may be partial or inconclusive.

content.text: When analysis cannot close a case, you will see partiality or warnings. That is not arbitrary failure: it means available evidence is insufficient for a strong conclusion under the engine’s rules. Next steps are to narrow the example, simplify the program, or add manual reasoning. Check the outcome in the
to see patterns the engine closes versus those that stay open.

blocks.title: Example: WHILE with two coupled variables
blocks.caption: Iteration count depends on how a and b relate; without a clear invariant or bound, the engine may report partial analysis. Reduce the case (fixed values) and reason by hand before demanding a single label.
